subtopics.title: Buying on Credit — the Invoice Received and the CJ

questions.question: Lindi's General Store buys stock on credit from Coastal Wholesalers. In Lindi's books, Coastal is:
options: A creditor — a liability, money the business owes
A debtor — money receivable
An expense
An asset

questions.question: The source document for a credit purchase is:
options: A duplicate receipt
The invoice received from the supplier, renumbered into the business's own sequence
A credit note issued by the business
The delivery note alone

questions.question: The Creditors Journal has no cost of sales column because:
options: Cost of sales is recorded weekly instead
The column was moved to the CRJ
Buying loads the shelf at cost — one truth; the two-truths pattern belongs to selling
Creditors never supply trading stock

subtopics.title: Recording and Posting the Creditors Journal

questions.question: Stock of R8 500 is bought on credit from Coastal. The daily posting to Coastal's personal account is:
options: A debit of R8 500 — Coastal owes us more
A credit of R8 500 — we owe more, and liabilities grow on the credit side
No entry until month end
A debit of R8 500 to Trading Stock in the Creditors Ledger

questions.question: The display counter of R4 000 bought on credit from FitOut Traders is analysed to:
options: Trading Stock, because it stands in the shop
Stationery, because it is small
Sundries: Drawings
Equipment — an asset kept for use

questions.question: The CJ cross-cast for the month proves:
options: Trading Stock 8 500 + Stationery 600 + Equipment 4 000 = Creditors Control 13 100
Creditors Control equals the bank balance
The list of creditors equals the trial balance
Total purchases equal total sales

questions.question: At month end the Creditors Control column total of R13 100 posts as:
options: A debit to Creditors Control
A credit to Bank
A credit to Creditors Control — the group liability grew
A debit to Trading Stock only

subtopics.title: Returns to Suppliers — the Debit Note and the CAJ

questions.question: When Lindi returns damaged goods to Coastal, the document SHE issues is:
options: A credit note
A numbered debit note stating the supplier's account is reduced, and why
A new invoice
A monthly statement

questions.question: The CAJ month-end totals of Creditors Control R850, Trading Stock R700 and Stationery R150 post as:
options: Credit Creditors Control R850; debit Trading Stock R700; debit Stationery R150
Debit Creditors Control R850; debit Trading Stock R700; credit Stationery R150
Debit Bank R850; credit Creditors Control R850
Debit Creditors Control R850; credit Trading Stock R700; credit Stationery R150

questions.question: Returns to suppliers carry no cost-of-sales adjustment because:
options: The goods were bought at cost and return at cost — only selling creates the two-truths pair
Cost of sales is only recorded in December
Suppliers refuse to accept cost figures
The CAJ has no columns for amounts

subtopics.title: The Creditors Ledger, the List, and the Discipline of Paying

questions.question: Coastal's personal account shows a credit of 8 500 and a debit of 700. Its balance is:
options: R7 800 credit — the business owes Coastal R7 800
R7 800 debit
R9 200 credit
R700 debit

questions.question: The list of creditors totals R12 250. Creditors Control shows credit 13 100 and debit 850. This means:
options: An error of R850 exists
The list and control agree at R12 250 credit, as they must
R12 250 must be paid immediately
The control account should be closed

questions.question: The three-document match before paying an invoice compares:
options: The invoice, the bank statement and the trial balance
The order, the credit note and the receipt
The order, the delivery note and the invoice — all three must tell one story
The budget, the invoice and the statement

subtopics.title: The Other Side of the Counter

questions.question: After buying on credit from Coastal, Lindi is now:
options: A name on a page in Coastal's debtors book
A creditor of Coastal
The owner of Coastal's stock account
Free of any obligation

questions.question: In the creditors book, a bigger balance means:
options: More money coming in someday — an asset
More money going out someday — a debt growing on the credit side
Higher profit this month
More stock on the shelf

questions.question: When Lindi buys R8 500 of stock, only one truth is written because:
options: The supplier records the second truth
Small amounts never need two entries
The stock was damaged
The shelf loads at cost — the two-truths dance belongs to selling

subtopics.title: The Month of Buying on Trust

questions.question: The three purchases — stock R8 500, stationery R600, counter R4 000 — find their homes as:
options: Asset, asset, expense
Stock, expense, asset
Expense, stock, stock
Stock, asset, expense

questions.question: The debit note for the damaged R700 box is described as 'a letter with numbers' because it:
options: Is Lindi's own numbered document reducing what she owes, on her own timeline
Contains the supplier's phone number
Replaces the original order
Is issued by the bank

questions.question: At month end the pages read Coastal R7 800, Karoo R450, FitOut R4 000, and the summary line shows:
options: R12 250 — the lock clicks

questions.question: Invoiced for ten boxes but only nine were delivered. The professional response is:
options: Pay the invoice and hope for a refund
Pay for nine boxes without paperwork
Ignore the invoice entirely
A debit note conversation — never a payment on a mismatched invoice

questions.question: Paying suppliers needlessly early is poor discipline because:
options: Supplier credit is free financing — the business starves itself of cash it could hold all month
Suppliers dislike early payments
It increases the debt
The bank charges double for early EFTs

questions.question: When the supplier's monthly statement differs from their page in Lindi's book:
options: The supplier's version automatically wins
The documents decide — two independent records are reconciled and queries raised early
Lindi's version automatically wins
Both records are discarded and rebuilt
